environment.description: Node.js 18 Apollo GraphQL server deployed on ECS Fargate behind an Application Load Balancer with default listener rules. PostgreSQL 14 accessed via pgBouncer 1.19 in transaction pooling mode with prepared statement support (server_prepared_statements=yes). JWT_PUBLIC_KEY is the RSA public key in PEM format loaded from AWS Secrets Manager. The jsonwebtoken library version is 8.5.1. No additional middleware or request validation layers.

config.database: PostgreSQL 14 via pgBouncer 1.19 (transaction mode, prepared statements enabled)
config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with default HTTP/HTTPS listener, no WAF attached
config.network: VPC with public ALB, private subnets for ECS and RDS
